newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 22.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Former judge Lee Hoi-chang was elected on Monday as the ruling New Korea Party's candidate for presidential elections in December.
- President Kim Young-sam is expected to reshuffle the party and his cabinet early next month following consulations with presidential candidate Lee Hoi-chang.
- The Office of Bank Supervision on Monday called on the heads of the major creditor banks of the Kia Group to extend financial support to suppliers of the troubled group.

- Overcapacity problems of the local auto industry, which is partly responsible for financial trouble of South Korea's third largest carmaker Kia, is likely to spark another round of trade disputes with Washington and Brussels.
